items.q: Do I still need my phone?
items.a: No. NEXUS has its own eSIM, so calls, messages, navigation, and payments all work standalone. You can pair it with a phone if you want, but it isn't required.

items.q: How does the AR display work in daylight?
items.a: The micro-OLED panels hit 5,000 nits peak brightness, well above direct sunlight glare, and automatically dim indoors so the overlay never washes out or blinds you.

items.q: What happens to my health data?
items.a: Biometric processing happens entirely on-device using the N1 neural chip. Nothing leaves your frame unless you explicitly choose to sync it to the companion app.

items.q: Can I wear NEXUS with prescription lenses?
items.a: Yes. Every frame ships with a magnetic prescription-insert slot, and we support single-vision inserts up to +/-6.00 diopters at checkout.
Preorders placed today are estimated to ship in Q3 2026. You'll get firmware updates over the air before your unit even arrives.
